player_prompt.intro:
Keddi tafukk {player_id} deg Chopsticks. Deg waktil, efk ad wi:
  + Dukel:  '[attack M O]'  ande M=afus-ik (0 neɣ 1), O=afus n imɣazi (0 neɣ 1).
    - Tifira n afus n imɣazi tawey teddu s afus-ik; ma yella >=5, ad yuɣal 0.
  + Bḍu:   '[split L R]'  akken ad tefk tifira-ik s L akked R (L+R = tifira-ik).
Sewwiɣ s yiwen n wawalen-a.

invalid_move.invalid_command: Aseɣwen ur yezmir ad yili. Sken “[attack M O]” neɣ “[split L R]”.

game_action.attack: K{player_id} itdukkel K{opp_id} s afus {opp_idx}: ad yuɣal seg {opp_val} ɣer {new_val}.
